title: Japanese Money Methods
note:
THE RECAP AND THE CLOSE. B is held across all four recap frames and each
     carries its own chapter's mark redrawn small: the buy/skip fork from 4.10,
     the eight-and-two cells from 5.2-5.4, the four rows with the second one lit
     from 6.10, and the shared square from 7.4. Holding the layout makes them one
     list; the marks make each one a different frame. A recap is the one place in
     a cut where repeating a drawn device is the point rather than the failure.

     Ground arc: warm -> green -> green deeper -> amber on the one that governs
     the other three -> green for tonight -> neutral for the whole video -> the
     single pop frame -> warm out.

     Archetypes: B B B B A A D A. Nothing is drawn after s88: the last four
     frames are one page, one pen and a closed notebook, and every one of them is
     already the picture.
